# Human World (Human World Rules)

> 30 people and books on how the world actually works, across 2,600 years
> See how people before you handled it.

A knowledge base of the durable rules people have worked out about strategy, money, power, human nature and building things — drawn from 30 figures and classic texts across 2,600 years. Each entry gives the one idea that person is actually remembered for, the story behind it, the sub-principles with worked examples, and how it applies today.

## Read it

- Site: https://ourword.ai/en/
- Everything on one page: https://ourword.ai/en/all/
- Every entry has its own static page: https://ourword.ai/en/i/<slug>/
- Full text of everything, one file: https://ourword.ai/en/llms-full.txt
- All URLs: https://ourword.ai/en/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://ourword.ai/en/feed.xml

## Citing

Cite the individual page URL, not the homepage — each entry page is stable and dated. Attribute to "Human World (OurWord AI)".
